CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_finish_automation(p_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_outcome text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if length(p_outcome)>100 then raise exception 'Outcome too long';end if;
 update public.icash_automation_tickets set state=case when p_success then 'complete' else 'held' end,outcome=p_outcome,completed_at=now() where id=p_id and state='consumed' and not (kind='contacts' and owner_preview_deferrals>0);
end $function$

arguments: p_id uuid, p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_token text, p_success boolean, p_outcome text
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_finish_owner_enrichment(p_id uuid, p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_token text, p_success boolean, p_outcome text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_id is null or p_account is null or p_screening is null or p_token is null or p_success is null
  or p_outcome is null or length(p_outcome)>100 then return false;end if;
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 for update;
 update public.icash_automation_tickets set state=case when p_success then 'complete' else 'held' end,
  outcome=p_outcome,completed_at=clock_timestamp()
 where id=p_id and account_id=p_account and screening_id=p_screening and kind='contacts' and token=p_token and state='consumed';
 return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_issue_ready_voice_ticket()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare j public.icash_voice_jobs;t public.icash_automation_tickets;last_voice timestamptz;
begin
 perform public.icash_queue_voice_jobs();
 select last_dispatch_at into last_voice from public.icash_voice_scheduler where id=1 for update;
 if (last_voice is null or last_voice<now()-interval '3 seconds') and exists(select 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 and enabled) and public.icash_outgoing_voice_capacity_open() then
 select candidate.* into j from (
 select v.* from public.icash_voice_jobs v join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=v.account_id and not a.bot_paused join public.icash_voice_configs c on c.account_id=a.id and c.enabled
 join public.icash_wallets w on w.account_id=a.id and w.balance_cents>w.reserved_cents
 where v.state='ready' and v.due_at<=now()
 and exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_contact_targets current_target
  where current_target.id=coalesce(v.permission_id,v.operational_contact_id) and current_target.account_id=v.account_id
   and ((v.permission_id is not null and v.operational_contact_id is null and current_target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
    or (v.permission_id is null and v.operational_contact_id is not null and current_target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
   and current_target.revoked_at is null and current_target.permission_until>now())
 and not (v.callback_id is null and v.sms_source_message_id is null and v.cancellation_notice_id is null
  and v.operational_contact_id is null and v.meta_offer_lead_id is null and v.meta_followup_lead_id is null
  and exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_leads m
   join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=m.screening_id and s.account_id=m.account_id and s.state='awaiting_address'
   where m.account_id=v.account_id and (m.voice_job_id=v.id
    or m.voice_job_id is null and exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_permissions p
     where p.id=v.permission_id and p.account_id=m.account_id and p.screening_id=m.screening_id and p.seller_intake_id=m.lead_id))))
 and case
  when v.sms_source_message_id is not null then public.icash_requested_seller_call_current(v.account_id,v.id)
  when v.callback_id is not null then exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_live_callbacks cb
   join public.icash_live_conversations call on call.id=cb.conversation_id and call.account_id=cb.account_id
   join public.icash_voice_contact_targets target on target.id=coalesce(v.permission_id,v.operational_contact_id)
    and target.account_id=v.account_id and target.party='seller'
    and ((v.permission_id is not null and v.operational_contact_id is null and target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
     or (v.permission_id is null and v.operational_contact_id is not null and target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
   where cb.id=v.callback_id and cb.account_id=v.account_id and cb.screening_id=target.screening_id
    and cb.state='pending_dispatch_review' and cb.due_at=v.due_at and cb.due_at between now()-interval '15 minutes' and now()
    and call.screening_id=cb.screening_id and call.contact_key=target.contact_key and call.party='seller'
    and call.state='complete' and call.completed_at<=now() and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(call.result)
    and case when pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(call.result->>'callbackDueAt','timestamp with time zone')
     then (call.result->>'callbackDueAt')::timestamptz=cb.due_at else false end)
  when v.cancellation_notice_id is not null then public.icash_cancellation_voice_current(v.account_id,'voice:'||v.id)
  else false end
 order by v.due_at,v.id for update of v skip locked offset 0
 ) candidate
 where public.icash_voice_queue_slot_open(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
 and public.icash_seller_phone_call_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
 limit 1;
 if not found then
 select candidate.* into j from (
 select v.* from public.icash_voice_jobs v join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=v.account_id and not a.bot_paused join public.icash_voice_configs c on c.account_id=a.id and c.enabled
 join public.icash_wallets w on w.account_id=a.id and w.balance_cents>w.reserved_cents
 left join lateral(
  select recent.created_at from public.icash_automation_tickets recent
  where recent.account_id=v.account_id and recent.kind='voice_dispatch'
  order by recent.created_at desc limit 1
 ) last_ticket on true
 where v.state='ready' and v.due_at<=now()
 and exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_contact_targets current_target
  where current_target.id=coalesce(v.permission_id,v.operational_contact_id) and current_target.account_id=v.account_id
   and ((v.permission_id is not null and v.operational_contact_id is null and current_target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
    or (v.permission_id is null and v.operational_contact_id is not null and current_target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
   and current_target.revoked_at is null and current_target.permission_until>now())
 and not (v.callback_id is null and v.sms_source_message_id is null and v.cancellation_notice_id is null
  and v.operational_contact_id is null and v.meta_offer_lead_id is null and v.meta_followup_lead_id is null
  and exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_leads m
   join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=m.screening_id and s.account_id=m.account_id and s.state='awaiting_address'
   where m.account_id=v.account_id and (m.voice_job_id=v.id
    or m.voice_job_id is null and exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_permissions p
     where p.id=v.permission_id and p.account_id=m.account_id and p.screening_id=m.screening_id and p.seller_intake_id=m.lead_id))))
 order by last_ticket.created_at asc nulls first,v.due_at,v.id for update of v skip locked offset 0
 ) candidate
 where public.icash_voice_queue_slot_open(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
 and public.icash_seller_phone_call_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
 limit 1;
 end if;
 if found then
 update public.icash_voice_scheduler set last_dispatch_at=now() where id=1;
 update public.icash_voice_jobs set state='issued',updated_at=now() where id=j.id;
 insert into public.icash_automation_tickets(account_id,kind,voice_job_id) values(j.account_id,'voice_dispatch',j.id) returning * into t;return jsonb_build_object('token',t.token);
 end if;end if;
 return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_queue_voice_jobs()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare c public.icash_operational_contacts;b record;
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(726341927);
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 for update;
 perform public.icash_prepare_operational_contacts();
 perform public.icash_queue_voice_jobs_before_operational();
 for c in with prior_first_routes as materialized (
 select prior.account_id,target.screening_id,target.contact_key
 from public.icash_voice_jobs prior join public.icash_voice_contact_targets target
  on target.id=coalesce(prior.permission_id,prior.operational_contact_id) and target.account_id=prior.account_id
 where prior.callback_id is null
), candidates as materialized (
 select op.* from public.icash_operational_contacts op
 join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=op.account_id and not a.bot_paused
 join public.icash_voice_configs cfg on cfg.account_id=op.account_id and cfg.enabled and cfg.reviewed_until>now()
 join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=op.screening_id and s.account_id=op.account_id and s.state='complete' and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
 where op.channel='voice' and op.revoked_at is null and op.eligibility_until>now()
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_permissions legacy where legacy.account_id=op.account_id and legacy.screening_id=op.screening_id and legacy.phone=op.phone)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_outreach_campaigns campaign where campaign.account_id=op.account_id and campaign.mode='sms_inbound')
 and not exists(select 1 from prior_first_routes prior
  where prior.account_id=op.account_id and prior.screening_id=op.screening_id and prior.contact_key=op.contact_key)
 ) select op.* from candidates op
 where case when public.icash_outreach_voice_current(op.account_id) then
  (not exists(select 1 from public.icash_dnc_verification_receipts receipt where receipt.id=op.dnc_receipt_id and receipt.evidence_kind='national_provider_observation')
   or public.icash_operational_contact_current(op.account_id,op.id,'voice',false))
  else false end
 order by op.created_at,op.id limit 100
 loop
  if public.icash_operational_contact_current(c.account_id,c.id,'voice',false)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j join public.icash_voice_contact_targets target on target.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id)
    where j.account_id=c.account_id and target.account_id=c.account_id and target.screening_id=c.screening_id and target.contact_key=c.contact_key and j.callback_id is null)
  then insert into public.icash_voice_jobs(account_id,operational_contact_id) values(c.account_id,c.id) on conflict do nothing;end if;
 end loop;
 for b in with callback_candidates as materialized (
 select cb.id,cb.account_id,cb.due_at,op.id as target_id,op.dnc_receipt_id,op.created_at as contact_created_at from public.icash_live_callbacks cb
 join public.icash_live_conversations call on call.id=cb.conversation_id and call.account_id=cb.account_id and call.state='complete' and (call.result->>'callbackDueAt')::timestamptz=cb.due_at
 join public.icash_operational_contacts op on op.account_id=cb.account_id and op.screening_id=cb.screening_id and op.contact_key=call.contact_key and op.channel='voice'
 where public.icash_outreach_voice_current(cb.account_id) and call.party='seller' and cb.state='pending_dispatch_review' and cb.due_at>now()-interval '15 minutes'
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs job where job.callback_id=cb.id)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_outreach_campaigns campaign where campaign.account_id=cb.account_id and campaign.mode='sms_inbound')
 ) select candidate.id,candidate.account_id,candidate.due_at,candidate.target_id from callback_candidates candidate
 where (not exists(select 1 from public.icash_dnc_verification_receipts receipt where receipt.id=candidate.dnc_receipt_id and receipt.evidence_kind='national_provider_observation')
  or public.icash_operational_contact_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.target_id,'voice',false))
 order by candidate.due_at,candidate.contact_created_at desc limit 100
 loop
  if public.icash_operational_contact_current(b.account_id,b.target_id,'voice',false) then
   insert into public.icash_voice_jobs(account_id,operational_contact_id,callback_id,due_at) values(b.account_id,b.target_id,b.id,b.due_at) on conflict do nothing;
  end if;
 end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_voice_queue_slot_open(p_account uuid, p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j
  join public.icash_voice_contact_targets target on target.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id)
   and target.account_id=j.account_id and target.party='seller' and target.contact_key is not null
   and ((j.permission_id is not null and j.operational_contact_id is null and target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
    or (j.permission_id is null and j.operational_contact_id is not null and target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
  where j.id=p_job and j.account_id=p_account and j.state='ready'
 and public.icash_voice_capacity_available(j.account_id,(select agent_id from public.icash_voice_configs where account_id=j.account_id),'voice:'||j.id,target.contact_key,false)
  and not exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs busy where busy.id<>j.id
    and (busy.state in ('issued','dispatching') or (busy.state='held' and busy.outcome in ('provider_receipt_needs_reconciliation','provider_outcome_unknown_no_retry')))
    and (exists(
     select 1 from public.icash_voice_contact_targets other where other.id=coalesce(busy.permission_id,busy.operational_contact_id)
      and other.account_id=busy.account_id and other.contact_key=target.contact_key
      and ((busy.permission_id is not null and busy.operational_contact_id is null and other.eligibility_source='operator_record')
       or (busy.permission_id is null and busy.operational_contact_id is not null and other.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only')))))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations live where live.state in ('waiting','review')
   and (live.contact_key=target.contact_key))
 );
$function$
